spec_match.rationale: Exercises all four WebTransportDatagramStats counters by diffing two real getStats() snapshots around a burst aged out via the real datagrams.outgoingMaxAge setter — the exact mechanism the spec defines expiredOutgoing against.

interactive.rationale: Endpoint URL, numeric outgoingMaxAge and burst-size inputs, connect/burst/disconnect buttons, and a before/after/delta table filled only from resolved snapshots.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises maxAge-driven expiry counted as deltas between real snapshots; the page does exactly that and says so when no counter moves.

edge_cases.rationale: Handles no-WebTransport, method-missing, constructor-throw, connect timeout, session death mid-burst (InvalidStateError explanation), rejected write promises for expired datagrams, and the honest 'nothing moved on a fast link' outcome with concrete advice.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5120203192139776 plus the DatagramStats and outgoingMaxAge spec anchors.

conformance.rationale: Relies on the feature suite's verified surface/failure contracts (6/6 flagged, 0/6 unflagged on Chromium 153).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified on headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright-driven CDP; no chrome-devtools-mcp here) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3, unflagged and behind WebTransportStats: connect lands in the labelled failed state with the real handshake error, controls stay honest, zero page errors, no overflow. The burst/delta path needs an established session, which no network in this container can produce, so it remains unverified.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts snapshots-resolved on the burst path and the fallback/connect-failure branches; console prefixed [wt-stats:ledger].

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; delta column uses accent-emerald-dark on paper; buttons overriding background set color.

accessibility.rationale: All inputs natively labelled with hints, state chip and output are aria-live=polite, table has caption and scoped headers, 44px targets.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both viewports screenshotted and overflow-checked; the four-column table scrolls inside its wrapper on narrow screens.

openQuestions.title: Drive the expiry counters for real on a reachable endpoint
openQuestions.detail: From an unproxied network on a 159-class build, connect to echo.webtransport.day:4433, run the default 1ms/200-datagram burst, and confirm expiredOutgoing rises in the delta column (and that lostOutgoing/droppedIncoming stay plausible). Also worth confirming Chromium rejects or resolves the write() promises of expired datagrams as handled here.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Caption + scoped headers; horizontal scrolling confined to the table's own wrapper.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Before/after/delta table lives in .table-wrap (overflow-x:auto); no page-level overflow at 360px DPR3.

guidanceConsulted.query: range slider input accessible labeling and keyboard
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Native number inputs with labels, inputmode, sensible min/max, and visible constraint hints.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: maxAge and burst are native number inputs with label for, inputmode=numeric, min/max clamping mirrored in JS.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status updates live region after button action
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Route async outcomes through polite live regions on semantic elements.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: State chip and output element are aria-live=polite; outcomes are text-first, colour-second.

summary: A real cause-and-effect ledger for datagram death: tighten outgoingMaxAge, burst, diff two genuine snapshots. Every branch reachable without a live HTTP/3 endpoint is browser-verified honest on Chromium 153 flagged and unflagged.
